title: Notification configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.NotificationAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

CloseAfterTime.description: Milliseconds after which the notification closes itself; 0 or undefined keeps it open.

InteractToClose.description: Closes the notification on interaction outside it (click outside or Escape); ignored on native apps.

NeedsSwipes.description: Enables swipe gestures to dismiss the notification.

Position.description: Screen position: top (default), top-left, top-right, bottom, bottom-left, bottom-right or center.

StartsOpen.description: Shows the notification as soon as it is built.

Width.description: Width of the notification (CSS length); 370px by default.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
